sources.note: 18Birdies — PRIMARY per-hole source. Full 9-hole grid fetched successfully: tee labeled 'Black', per-hole yardage, par 3 on every hole, and handicap row 1/3/5/7/9/11/13/15/17. OUT row printed as par 27, 1073 yards. Also displays a doubled 18-hole total of 2146 yards and a 'rating 70 / slope 110' pair that I rejected — see collection_notes.

GolfLink — INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION via WebSearch result summaries only (domain is fetch-blocked per instructions, never fetched). Two separate searches returned the identical per-hole yardage set (100/95/100/150/115/115/134/82/182) and confirmed hole 1 = par 3 / HCP 1 / 100 yds, hole 2 = par 3 / HCP 3 / 95 yds, hole 7 = par 3 / HCP 13 / 134 yds, hole 9 = par 3 / HCP 17 / 182 yds 'from the Black tees'. A third search returned GolfLink's own rating/slope fields as '0.0' and '0'.
Official site returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch — no data extracted. Recorded for later human transcription; may carry a printed scorecard.

GolfPass — confirms address, 9 holes, par 27, 1073 yards, built 2003, and 'Open to the public, year-round (weather permitting)', supporting the assignment hint that this facility is OPEN. Publishes no per-hole grid and no rating/slope. NOTE: labels the single tee 'White', conflicting with 18Birdies/GolfLink which call it 'Black'.
Greenskeeper.org — HTTP 404, no page exists for this facility. (Do not confuse with Cleburne Golf Links, a separate 18-hole par-72 course in the same town that DOES have a Greenskeeper page.)
AllGolfHoles — HTTP 404, no page for this course.

collection_notes:
ARITHMETIC CHECK PASSED: per-hole lengths 100+95+100+150+115+115+134+82+182 = 1073, matching the published total of 1,073 exactly. Par 3 x 9 = 27, matching published par 27. Stroke index set is the nine odd values 1-17 with no repeats — the standard convention for a 9-hole card intended to be played twice around; all values are within the legal 1-18 range. Confidence is high because two independent sources (18Birdies fetched directly, GolfLink via search summary) returned byte-identical per-hole yardages and matching handicaps at the four holes I could spot-check.

RATING/SLOPE DELIBERATELY OMITTED. Sources conflict and all candidate values are implausible: 18Birdies shows 70/110 (against its doubled 2146-yard/18-hole line) and one search summary quoted 36/110 for the nine. A course rating of 70 against par 54, or 36 against par 27, would mean a scratch golfer averages 9 over par on nine par-3s — not credible. Decisive evidence: GolfLink's own rating and slope fields for this course read 0.0 and 0, i.e. the course carries NO official USGA/TGA rating. This is normal for a short par-3 practice course. Rather than propagate an aggregator's default-value artifact I recorded no ratings; the tee's ratings array is empty. If a real rating is ever needed it must come from the Texas Golf Association database or the printed card.

TEE NAME CONFLICT (unresolved): 18Birdies and GolfLink both label the single tee set 'Black'; GolfPass labels it 'White'. I used 'Black' because that is the name attached to the source that actually published the per-hole grid. Only one tee set is published anywhere, which is consistent with a 1,073-yard par-3 layout. Flagging for human verification against the physical card.

Par/handicap recorded as 'unisex' — no source printed separate men's and women's rows for this course.

STATUS: consistent with the assignment hint, evidence supports the course being OPEN (GolfPass lists it as open to the public year-round).

sources.note: Greenskeeper.org — PRIMARY SOURCE, fetched successfully. Complete per-hole grid for all three tees (Gold/Black/Silver) plus par and handicap rows, and the full rating/slope table: Gold 71 / 72.5 / 133 / 6593; Black 71 / 69.8 / 127 / 6041; Silver 71 / 65.6 / 117 / 5125; Black-Ladies 71 / 76.6 / 142 / 6041; Silver-Ladies 71 / 70.5 / 119 / 5125. Confirms address 700 Riverchase Drive, Coppell, TX 75019. Reported that men's and women's par/handicap rows are printed separately and carry identical values.

GolfPass — INDEPENDENT TEE-SHEET CORROBORATION. Back 6593 par 71 M 72.5/133; Middle 69.8/127 M; Forward 5125 M 65.6/113 and W 70.5/118. Confirms the three-tee structure and the men's Gold and Black ratings exactly. Uses generic tee names (Back/Middle/Forward) and shows minor slope variance on the Forward tee — see collection_notes. Also surfaced an older rating revision noted on the page as M 72.4/131 (back) and M 69.8/128 (middle).

GolfScorekeeper — summary only; per-hole scorecard is gated behind HTML/PDF selection links that WebFetch could not follow. Lists 'Mens 6593 par 71 rating 68.9 slope 114' and 'Mens White-NEW 6041 par 71 rating 69.8 slope 127'. The 68.9/114 figure for the 6593-yard tee is a stale/erroneous outlier contradicted by two better sources and was NOT used.

ForeTee — no per-tee breakdown. Gives only a single composite line: 6,593 yards, par 71, rating 72.0, slope 124. Not used for ratings; contradicted by the two primary sources. Confirms the course phone and that it is operating.

GolfLink — fetch-blocked per instructions, never fetched. WebSearch summary quoted 'Back 6600 yds (131/72.4), Middle 6040 yds (128/69.8), Forward 5125 yds (113/65.6)' for men plus corresponding women's tees, and confirms Jim Fazio design, opened 1988, par 71, Bermuda greens. Corroborates tee structure and totals; its slightly different numbers appear to be an older rating cycle.

collection_notes:
ARITHMETIC CHECK PASSED ON ALL THREE TEES — every one sums exactly to its published total, so I am confident no digit was misread:
  Gold: OUT 3306 + IN 3287 = 6593 (published 6,593) MATCH
  Black: OUT 3054 + IN 2987 = 6041 (published 6,041) MATCH
  Silver: OUT 2603 + IN 2522 = 5125 (published 5,125) MATCH
Par check: OUT 36 + IN 35 = 71, matching the published par 71 on every tee. Stroke-index check: the front nine carries the nine odd values (5,11,15,13,1,7,9,17,3) and the back nine the nine even values (6,2,12,18,4,10,14,8,16); all of 1-18 appear exactly once with no duplicates or gaps.

TEE NAMING: used Greenskeeper's Gold/Black/Silver, which read as the names actually printed on the card, rather than GolfPass's generic Back/Middle/Forward. The two map cleanly onto each other by yardage (Gold=Back 6593, Black=Middle 6041, Silver=Forward 5125).

GENDER RATINGS: per the one-tee/two-ratings rule, Greenskeeper's 'Black - Ladies' and 'Silver - Ladies' rows were folded into the existing Black and Silver tees as women's rating entries over a single shared set of yardages — they are NOT separate tees, since both carry yardages identical to their men's counterparts (6041 and 5125). The Gold tee has a men's rating only; no source publishes a women's rating from 6,593 yards.

SOURCE CONFLICTS (Greenskeeper preferred throughout, because it is the only source whose per-hole grid I could verify by summation, and its totals reconcile perfectly):
  - Silver men's slope: Greenskeeper 117 vs GolfPass 113. Used 117.
  - Silver women's slope: Greenskeeper 119 vs GolfPass 118. Used 119.
  - Black tee total: Greenskeeper/GolfLink 6041 vs one GolfPass line reading 6031. Used 6041, which is what the per-hole yardages actually sum to.
  - Gold rating: 72.5/133 (Greenskeeper + GolfPass, agreeing) vs an older 72.4/131 revision vs ForeTee's composite 72.0/124 vs GolfScorekeeper's 68.9/114. Used 72.5/133 on the strength of two-source agreement.
The minor slope discrepancies are consistent with different USGA rating cycles rather than transcription error, and none affect the per-hole data.

PAR/HANDICAP GENDER ROWS: Greenskeeper reports the card printing separate men's and women's par and handicap rows whose values are identical. Following the rule to supply both when both are printed, I populated 'men' and 'women' with the same values rather than collapsing to 'unisex'. Worth a human spot-check against the physical card, since women's stroke indexes usually differ from men's and identical rows can indicate the aggregator simply mirrored one row.

No per-hole data was invented or interpolated anywhere in this entry.
